WITH LatestSnapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS latest_date
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
HouseholdCountsByRegion AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region AS region,
        COUNT(d.id) AS member_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.head_of_household_id = hl.id
    CROSS JOIN LatestSnapshot ls
    WHERE d.death_date IS NULL
      AND d.person_type = 'Saudi'
      AND d.head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
          WHERE hp.id = d.id
            AND hp.snapshot = ls.latest_date
            AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      )
    GROUP BY hl.region, d.head_of_household_id
),
RegionalAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS avg_household_size
    FROM HouseholdCountsByRegion
    GROUP BY region
),
NationalAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS national_avg
    FROM HouseholdCountsByRegion
)
SELECT 
    ra.region,
    ra.avg_household_size,
    na.national_avg
FROM RegionalAverages ra
CROSS JOIN NationalAverage na
ORDER BY ra.avg_household_size DESC LIMIT 20000
